title: Summarize a Long Document
description: Use AI to extract the key insights from a long document — report, paper, or policy — in minutes instead of hours.
steps: Choose a document you have been meaning to read but have not had time for (PDF, article, report)
Upload to Claude and prompt: "Summarize this document: 1) Main argument in one sentence, 2) 5 key points, 3) Key data or findings, 4) Conclusions and recommendations"
Ask: "What are the strongest and weakest arguments in this document?"
Ask: "What important questions does this document NOT answer?"
Rate the summary against a quick skim of the original document
expectedOutput: A structured summary of a real document you needed to understand, plus your accuracy rating.
bonusChallenges: Compare summaries from two documents and ask AI to synthesize the key themes across both
Ask AI to identify any contradictions between the document and what you already know about the topic
